description: Manual estimand and pairing annotations on top of the ExerGeneDB sample-level gold (exergenedb_samples.csv). ExerGeneDB labels every sample control or treatment along one axis per series. These annotations name that axis, list the other exercise axes the paper itself analyses, give pairing gold per axis, and correct sample labels that contradict the GEO record. Scored by test/experiments/paper_evidence_ablation/estimand_scoring.py.
annotator: Claude, from GEO metadata and the article abstract/methods

estimands.acute_bout: Before versus after one exercise session in the same subjects, or an exercised versus non-exercised limb after one session.
estimands.training: Effect of a training programme assigned by the investigators: before versus after training in the same subjects, or trained versus sedentary animals after a training or wheel-running period.
estimands.habitual: Cross-sectional comparison of pre-existing groups, such as athletes versus untrained people or trained versus sedentary volunteers.

fields.gold_estimand: The axis the ExerGeneDB control/treatment labels encode.
fields.paper_estimands: Exercise axes the article reports as its own comparisons. A contrast on any of these, or on gold_estimand, is admissible.
fields.pairing: Gold pairing for the gold axis: required (the same subjects contribute to both arms, so the analysis must block on subject), not_required, or unknown (excluded from pairing scores).
fields.subject: Where subject identity lives: a metadata column and, when the ID is embedded in a longer string, a regex whose first group is the subject. pairing_column is the column a model should name.
fields.alternate_axes: Other admissible axes. roles lists rules (column, control values, treatment values) that assign sample roles for that axis; columns may be the __replicate_grouped pseudo-columns used by the validator.
fields.label_corrections: Samples whose ExerGeneDB role contradicts the GEO record, with the corrected role.

GSE109657.evidence: ABS.p1: 11 young men before and after a 6-week HIIT programme.
GSE109657.notes: Assumes the replicate number in Muscle_pre_N / Muscle_post_N is the participant; GEO does not say so.

GSE115645.evidence: ABS.p1: randomised three-condition crossover; uninterrupted sitting versus sitting broken by light- or moderate-intensity walking, biopsy after each condition.
GSE115645.notes: Arms exist only in the description column with per-sample suffixes; control is uninterrupted sitting.

GSE117070.evidence: ABS.p1 and titles participant.<id>.pre.training / .post.training: endurance training in the same participants.

GSE117161.evidence: Separate mice per running protocol and time of day (titles Basal_Early_A, High_Late_B ...).
GSE117161.notes: Moderate and High are both treatment arms; either against Basal is correct. Moderate versus High is an intensity contrast, not exercise versus control.

GSE132520.evidence: Gold: wild-type mice 3 h after exercise versus sedentary; separate animals.
GSE132520.notes: Gold covers wild-type mice; the CaMKII mutant is a genotype stratum.

GSE140089.evidence: ABS.p1: 5 participants with PD before and after 16-week resistance training; subject_id PD-02-0 / PD-02-16.
GSE140089.notes: Gold covers only the PD subset (9 of 41 samples); older and young adult baseline groups are an age/disease contrast.

GSE144133.evidence: ABS.p2: biopsies from young sedentary men before and after 6 weeks of endurance training; GEO 'Untrained'/'Trained' are the pre/post timepoints of P1-P8.

GSE144627.evidence: ABS.p1: trained and sedentary older men at Pre, Post and 3hPost; regular exercise assessed as trained versus sedentary at baseline, acute exercise as baseline versus post within each group.

alternate_axes.notes: The paper restricts this comparison to Pre samples; a whole-column contrast also mixes post-exercise samples.

GSE156247.evidence: ABS.p2: vastus lateralis before and after a 12-week training intervention in the same subjects.
GSE156247.notes: Same article and subjects as GSE53598, but this series exposes subject and time point as columns.

GSE163356.evidence: ABS.p1: 7 weeks of combined training, biopsies before and after training; GEO has Pre/Post of the first and the ninth/last session for subjects A-K.

alternate_axes.notes: Training effect proper is First-session Pre versus Last-session Pre; the whole-column contrast also carries post-bout samples.

GSE164798.evidence: ABS.p1: 5xFAD and wild-type mice after 1-day (acute) or 30-day (chronic) wheel running versus sedentary; separate animals.
GSE164798.notes: The gold pools 1-day and 30-day running as treatment, so either against sedentary scores on the gold axis. Genotype is a stratum.

GSE167046.evidence: ABS.p2: sedentary versus treadmill-trained mice on control or high-energy diet; separate animals.
GSE167046.notes: Diet is a stratum, not an exercise axis.

GSE1832.evidence: ABS.p2: one-leg acute resistance exercise; exercised and non-exercised legs biopsied at 6 h and 18 h in the same patients.
GSE1832.notes: Subject and arm exist only in free-text titles with typos; no metadata column separates the arms.

GSE18801.evidence: ABS.p2: mice with swimming-induced physiological hypertrophy versus controls; separate animals.

GSE195585.evidence: ABS.p1: biopsies at baseline and 1, 4 and 24 h after high-load resistance exercise in each participant.
GSE195585.notes: Gold covers the placebo arm only; the verum (collagen peptide) arm is unlabelled.

GSE202295.evidence: ABS.p1: acute exercise in NGT and T2D; titles NGT_003_basal / _post / _rec.

GSE217155.evidence: ABS.p2: aerobic exercise in NASH mice on the Ath diet versus sedentary NASH mice; separate animals.
GSE217155.notes: The unlabelled third group is the normal-diet control (a diet contrast).

GSE218103.evidence: S2.6.p1: pre- and post-exercise samples were pooled to N = 3 per timepoint per group; GEO CON = pre-exercise pool, EX = post-exercise pool.
GSE218103.notes: Pooled samples, so whether pools are matched across timepoints is not stated.

GSE224310.evidence: ABS.p3: biopsies before, 60 min after the first and last bout, and 5 days after an 8-week intervention; source names end 'derived from subject N'.

control: Muscle biopsy before training derived from subject
Subcutaneous adipose tissue biopsies untrained before exercise derived from subject
treatment: Muscle biopsy post training derived from subject
Subcutaneous adipose tissue biopsies post training before exercise derived from subject

alternate_axes.notes: Rested samples before versus after the 8-week intervention.

GSE224310.notes: Muscle and adipose tissue are strata.

GSE229755.evidence: ABS.p2: mice running for 6 weeks versus sedentary mice.

GSE233340.evidence: ABS.p1: 6 weeks of voluntary wheel running versus no-wheel controls; separate mice.
GSE233340.notes: Gold covers wild-type mice; FLExDUX4 genotype is a disease stratum.

GSE24235.evidence: ABS.p1: unilateral acute resistance exercise after 12 weeks of training; bilateral biopsies compare the exercised (T) and non-exercised (UT) arm of the same person.
GSE24235.notes: Sex is a stratum the paper analyses separately.

GSE27536.evidence: S2.4.p1: biopsies at rest before and after training in all participants; GEO 'Sedentary healthy' and 'Trained healthy' share individual IDs 1-15.
GSE27536.notes: Gold covers the healthy subjects; COPD groups are a disease stratum. 'Sedentary'/'Trained' read as two groups but are pre/post timepoints.

GSE29075.evidence: ABS.p1: adult and aged mice housed with or without running wheels for 8 weeks.

GSE31839.evidence: S2.1.p1: activity factor with inactive and active levels in four activity-by-genotype groups of mice; separate animals.
GSE31839.notes: Gold covers wild-type mice only; myostatin genotype is a second factor the paper crosses with activity.

GSE36330.evidence: ABS.p2: female mice after 7 or 21 days of voluntary wheel running versus non-pregnant sedentary controls.
GSE36330.notes: Pregnancy groups are unlabelled; they are a different hypertrophy model.

GSE43219.evidence: ABS.p2: biopsies at rest and 30 min after one acute bout in 14 participants; titles MM29_rest / MM29_exercise.

GSE45041.evidence: ABS.p1: blood before and after 30 min treadmill running in the same participants.

GSE46075.evidence: ABS.p2: whole blood of eight athletes before and after exercise and during recovery.
GSE46075.notes: Two exercise tests (MT and RTE), each with its own baseline.

GSE47881.evidence: ABS.p1: profiles before and after 20 weeks of supervised resistance training in the same individuals.
GSE47881.notes: ExerGeneDB records the post samples as '2.5h post exercise', but the GEO axis is pre- versus post-training.

GSE48405.evidence: ABS.p1: blood before and 60 min, 1 day and 3 days after one resistance exercise session.

GSE51216.evidence: ABS.p1: masters athletes versus untrained controls, each sampled before and after an acute bout.

GSE53598.evidence: ABS.p2: vastus lateralis before and after a 12-week training intervention; titles GL23_before / GL23_after.
GSE53598.notes: Arms exist only in titles; no metadata column separates them.

GSE64607.evidence: ABS.p1: mice running or given AICAR for 3, 7 or 14 days; separate animals.
GSE64607.notes: AICAR arm is unlabelled; vehicle-injected sedentary mice are the control.

GSE65978.evidence: ABS.p1: high-fat diet mice after a 16-week running programme versus sedentary; separate animals.
GSE65978.notes: The unlabelled group is normal diet (a diet contrast).

GSE68161.evidence: ABS.p1: scWAT from mice after 11 days of wheel running versus sedentary mice.

GSE7640.evidence: ABS.p1: trained (n = 10) versus control (n = 10) rats after 10 weeks of treadmill training.

GSE92719.evidence: Description: mice underwent an acute bout of 1300 m treadmill running; separate sedentary mice per tissue.
GSE92719.notes: Five tissues are strata; AMPK-activator arms are unlabelled. Exercise and sedentary arms appear only in per-sample titles.
